claims.summary: The reviewed sources document Hanyu Pinyin as a transcription system; no broader claims about use prevalence or educational outcomes are made.

sourceLinks.notes: The source identifies the system as a Pinyin scheme for representing pronunciation; unrelated usage/prevalence claims were removed.

semanticReview.method: Manual claim-by-claim comparison with the Taiwan National Academy for Educational Research entry and MOE transcription guide

findings.supports: The source defines the Pinyin scheme and lists alphabet, initials, finals, tone marks and separator.
The Ministry transcription guide includes the syllable table and the examples ma/媽 and ni/你.

limitations: Removed unsupported claims about prevalence in Taiwan, technology use, educational outcomes and broad claims about tone meaning. This is a revalidation of an entry that already had VERIFIED status.
